caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The pitcher is rendered in varying shades of blue, with highlights suggesting a shiny, possibly glass or ceramic surface. It has a wide spout on the left, a large, curved handle on the right, and a broad body that narrows slightly at the base. The surface of the pitcher is decorated with intricate geometric and floral patterns, including oval shapes, zigzags, and elongated pointed arches. The base has a ridged texture, while the upper section features raised, rounded designs and decorative bands wrapping around the vessel. There are no other objects in the drawing, and the composition is centered and uncluttered, focusing solely on the detailed pitcher.
title: Early Sandwich Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
